XFAIL BUG: the 99-per-line limit is only checked per request; adding 1 then 99 gives a line of 100 (found 2026-11-10)

AssertionError: a cart line must never exceed 99 items, got 100
assert 100 <= 99
Cart line cannot exceed 99 by adding twice

XFAIL BUG: search returns nothing for product names containing 'with', e.g. 'Claw Hammer with Shock Reduction Grip' (found 2026-11-10)

AssertionError: customers can't find these products by their exact name: ['Claw Hammer with Shock Reduction Grip']
assert not ['Claw Hammer with Shock Reduction Grip']
Products with with in the name can be found

XFAIL BUG: POST /invoices accepts an EMPTY cart and creates an order with no items and total 0 (found 2026-11-10)

AssertionError: an empty cart must be rejected: 201 {"billing_street":"Lesingel 8","billing_city":"Steensel","billing_state":"Noord-Holland","billing_country":"NL","billing_postal_code":"1012AB","user_id":"01m7a2atk8nwkekfz5fnypw7ff","invoice_date":"20
assert 400 <= 201
 +  where 201 = <Response [201]>.status_code
Empty cart cannot be ordered

XFAIL BUG: ordering does not reduce stock; admin stock stays the same after a 201 order, e.g. Hammer 24 -> 24 after 3 units (found 2026-11-10)

AssertionError: stock of Claw Hammer with Shock Reduction Grip must drop by at least the 1 ordered, else we oversell: 25 -> 25
assert 25 <= (25 - 1)
Ordering reduces stock by the ordered quantity

XFAIL BUG: the same cart can be ordered twice; both POST /invoices return 201 and two invoices exist (found 2026-11-10)

AssertionError: re-submitting a used cart must be rejected: 201
assert 400 <= 201
 +  where 201 = <Response [201]>.status_code
Same cart cannot be ordered twice
